Riven is an experienced warrior.

She is calm and physically composed after training.

Her large sword remains exactly consistent with the reference.


ALLY SOLDIER:

Use the provided Ally Soldier reference image as the strict primary character reference.

Preserve his facial identity, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing, armor design, weapon design, and overall appearance exactly as shown in the reference.

This is the SAME Ally Soldier who trained with Riven in Scene 11.

He is a capable soldier.

After a long training session with Riven, he is noticeably more physically tired than she is.

His clothing and armor may have some natural dirt and dust from training.

He is comfortable enough around Riven to joke with her casually.


=== CHARACTER COUNT — IMPORTANT ===

Exactly TWO human characters appear anywhere in the entire scene:

1. Riven
2. Ally Soldier

The military training camp is otherwise visually empty.

Do not generate background soldiers.

Do not generate distant people.

Do not generate human silhouettes.

Do not duplicate Riven.

Do not duplicate Ally Soldier.

There must never be multiple versions of either character.

Only ONE Riven exists.

Only ONE Ally Soldier exists.


=== ENVIRONMENT LOCK ===

Use the provided Training Camp reference as the strict environment reference.

This is the SAME military training camp from Scenes 10 and 11.

Preserve the recognizable training yard, worn dirt ground, wooden training equipment, weapon racks, training dummies, military tents, wooden structures, banners, surrounding mountain landscape, and overall environmental design.

The scene now takes place at sunset.

The sun is low near the mountain horizon.

Warm natural golden-orange evening light passes across the camp.

Long soft shadows stretch across the dirt training ground.

Warm sunset light catches the edges of Riven's pale-blonde hair, both characters' armor, wooden structures, tents, and banners.

Keep the sunset realistic, restrained, and cinematic.

Do not create an extremely colorful fantasy sky.

The distant mountains are slightly cooler and darker through natural atmospheric haze.

Gentle evening wind moves Riven's hair, clothing, tent fabric, banners, and nearby grass.

The training camp is quiet at the end of the day.

Feature-film quality.

Realistic human anatomy.

Realistic cloth, hair, dust, and environmental physics.

Keep the scene simple and natural.

Avoid excessive cuts.

Use clear natural English pronunciation.

Speak the written dialogue exactly as written.

Do not translate the dialogue.

No background conversations.

Natural accurate lip synchronization.

No subtitles.

No captions.

No text.

No watermark.

No logo.


=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

Some time has passed since the training in Scene 11.

The training session has ended for the moment.

Riven and Ally Soldier are resting together at the edge of the same training yard during sunset.

Ally Soldier is much more tired after training.

Riven is tired but remains more physically composed.

Their relationship has become noticeably more comfortable.

They can now casually joke with each other.

The scene begins as a quiet moment after training.

Near the end, Ally Soldier chooses to get back up and continue practicing.

Riven sees his determination.

Instead of stopping him, she gets up and follows him back toward the training yard.

Do not show another full sparring match.

The scene ends before they begin fighting again.


=== SCENE ===

Begin at the edge of the training yard during sunset.

Riven and Ally Soldier are already resting beside simple training equipment near the edge of the yard.

They may sit against a low wooden structure, near a weapon rack, or beside a few rough wooden crates.

Keep their positions natural and relaxed.

Riven's large sword rests safely beside her.

Riven sits comfortably.

She slowly wipes dirt from part of her hand, forearm armor, or sword.

Her breathing is calm and natural.

Ally Soldier sits nearby.

He is visibly more exhausted.

His posture is looser after the long training session.

He takes a deeper breath and briefly rubs his shoulder or upper arm.

There is dirt on parts of his armor and clothing from repeatedly hitting the training ground.

Do not make him seriously injured.

For a short moment, neither character speaks.

Allow the quiet sunset atmosphere to exist naturally.

The warm evening light falls across both characters.

The banners and tent fabric move gently in the wind.

Ally Soldier looks across the training yard.

Then he glances toward Riven.

A small amused expression appears.

Ally Soldier:

"You ever get tired of saving me?"

Riven continues casually cleaning dirt from her equipment.

She does not immediately look at him.

Riven:

"Constantly."

Ally Soldier smiles.

He adjusts his sitting position and looks toward her again.

Ally Soldier:

"Good. I was worried you liked me."

Riven stops what she is doing.

She slowly looks toward him.

Her expression is dry but familiar.

Riven:

"Don't push it."

Ally Soldier laughs naturally.

His shoulders move naturally with the laugh.

Riven looks away again.

She tries to remain serious, but a very small restrained smile appears.

No more dialogue.

Allow a short comfortable silence.

Ally Soldier looks back toward the empty training yard.

His expression gradually becomes more focused.

He takes a breath.

Then he places one hand against the ground or nearby wooden structure and pushes himself back onto his feet.

His body shows some natural soreness from the training.

He rolls one shoulder.

He stretches his arm briefly.

Then he reaches down and picks up his weapon.

Riven notices.

She watches him without speaking.

Ally Soldier looks toward the training yard.

He adjusts his grip on his weapon.

Then he begins walking back toward the open training area.

He is clearly tired.

But he wants to continue.

Riven remains seated for a moment.

She watches him walk away.

Her expression subtly changes.

She recognizes his determination.

Riven looks down at her large sword beside her.

Then she reaches for it.

Riven stands naturally.

She lifts the sword with familiar controlled weight.

Ally Soldier continues walking toward the center of the training yard.

Riven begins walking after him.

Do not make her run.

Do not make either character speak.

The camera gradually widens.

Riven and Ally Soldier move toward the open training yard under the warm sunset light.

Ally Soldier walks slightly ahead.

Riven follows several steps behind.

The low sun sits near the distant mountain ridges.

Long shadows stretch across the worn dirt.

Warm evening light catches Riven's pale-blonde hair and the edges of their armor.

The quiet training camp and mountains surround them.

Ally Soldier reaches the open training area.

Riven approaches behind him.

Do not begin another sparring sequence.

Do not show them attacking each other.

End while both characters are returning to the training yard.

CUT.


=== END STATE FOR CONTINUITY ===

Riven and Ally Soldier remain in the same Training Camp from Scenes 10 and 11.

The day is ending.

Their long training session has brought them closer.

They are now comfortable enough to casually joke with each other.

Ally Soldier is physically exhausted but still chooses to continue practicing.

Riven sees that he refuses to give up.

She chooses to get up and return to the training yard with him.

Neither character is injured.

Both weapons remain intact.

Exactly one Riven and exactly one Ally Soldier remain in the scene.

No other human characters appear.

The scene ends before another sparring session begins.


=== MOOD ===

Warm.

Quiet.

Relaxed.

Slightly playful.

Cinematic sunset atmosphere.

Do not make the scene romantic.

Do not make it sentimental.

Do not make Ally Soldier worship Riven.

Do not make Riven behave like a formal instructor.

The important emotional idea is Ally Soldier's persistence.

He is exhausted.

He could stop.

Instead, he gets back up.

Riven notices.

The final image should be simple and cinematic:

Riven and Ally Soldier returning together toward the empty training yard as the sun sets behind the mountains.、16:9
